post.description:
A private demo account, no password. Body optional: {} or none = copy of the default
persona; {"crew": "iss-flight"|"iss-aligned"|"iss-misaligned"} = copy of that NASA-calibrated
crew member; {"profile": {...5 answers}} = the visitor's own synthetic 14 nights (~5 s).
404 unless DEMO_ACCESS=1; 503 demo_full once DEMO_MAX_USERS visitors exist.

429 + Retry-After after too many failed logins (config.yaml auth:). The client IP is
the direct peer: correct for the localhost demo; behind a proxy, configure the server's
forwarded-allow-ips so it is the real client.
Revoke the refresh token. Idempotent: an unknown token is not an error.

get.description:
The caller's persona, ready as soon as a persona quiz is submitted (no nights needed).
psyche60 (preferred): quadrant + feedback-style flags + advice matched to the latest
night and recent check-ins (empty while a safety screen is pending). mini_ipip: traits.
available=false until a quiz is taken. Never changes scores, alerts or the safety path.

The pet's single speech bubble for the caller. Safety first: while a safety screen is
pending it is the crisis card (playful=false, ui_action HALT_AND_OPEN_CRISIS_SCREEN). Voice
comes from the persona quadrant (traits never change thresholds). bubble=null before the
first night. Never contains scores.
